draft.subject: Hardware and Electronics Intern role at NDimensions Labs
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am interested in the Hardware and Electronics Intern, Robotics role at NDimensions Labs. Since the role includes design and prototyping of mechanical and electromechanical parts, I wanted to write to the person who leads design.

My background is electronics first, but I have worked across the line. As General Secretary of my university robotics club I owned mechanical design and PCB fabrication for competition robots, and I ran workshops on SolidWorks, Arduino and PCB design. In my capstone I integrated servos, a gripper and distance sensors on a robot arm and iterated on them until grasping was reliable.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
